title: Fast at the Frontier, Wrong at the Fallback: A Commit-Level Analysis of Threshold Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.20693v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can write several tokens per forward pass. Open-weight DLMs commit, in any order, every masked position whose confidence passes a threshold. If none does, a fallback commits the most confident one, and the commits are never revised. Wide windows let the decoder commit far ahead of the text, which should speed up decoding but often costs accuracy. It is unclear where the model is confident and which commits cause errors. We trace every commit of four off-the-shelf DLMs on math, code, translation and summarization, and rerun failing answers with one step changed. Most tokens become confident only near the frontier, the leftmost masked position, so committing only there, still several tokens per step, is about as fast as committing anywhere. The accuracy loss comes from committing tokens before the text to their left, and committing one token per step does not reduce it. The worst case is an early end-of-seq

translated_title: 前沿快，回退错：扩散语言模型中阈值解码的提交级分析
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLM）可以在每次前向传播中生成多个 token。开源权重的 DLM 会以任意顺序提交所有置信度超过阈值的被掩码位置；如果没有位置达到阈值，则启用回退机制提交置信度最高的一个位置，且已提交的 token 永远不会被修改。宽窗口使解码器能够远远超前于已有文本进行提交，这本应加快解码速度，但往往会损害准确率。目前尚不清楚模型究竟在哪些位置有信心，以及哪些提交导致了错误。我们在数学、代码、翻译和摘要任务上追踪了四个现成 DLM 的每一次提交，并通过只改变其中一步来重跑失败答案。研究发现：大多数 token 只有在前沿（即最左侧的被掩码位置）附近才会变得有信心，因此仅在前沿提交（每步仍可提交多个 token）与在任意位置提交一样快。准确率的损失来自于在文本左侧尚未生成的内容之前提前提交 token，而每步只提交一个 token 也无法减少这种损失。最坏的情况是过早提交序列结束符。
tldr: 该论文通过对四个扩散语言模型在数学、代码、翻译和摘要任务上的提交级追踪分析发现，准确率损失主要来自在文本前方提前提交 token，而仅在前沿（最左掩码位置）提交既不损失速度又能避免大部分错误。
en_tdlr: A commit-level analysis of threshold decoding in diffusion language models shows that accuracy loss stems mainly from committing tokens ahead of the frontier, and restricting commits to the frontier position preserves speed without sacrificing accuracy.
